verdict.rationale: Sumsub supports background automation implicitly via webhooks (automatic event notifications), verification levels (automated multi-step verification sequences), and AML screening configuration that runs automatically — plus an MCP server letting AI agents perform operations autonomously under role permissions. However, there's no dedicated workflow/rules builder or scheduler described as enabling arbitrary user-defined 'set and forget' automations beyond the verification pipeline itself. Missing for 10: an explicit automation/workflow orchestration feature, scheduling capability, and independent evidence of autonomous background runs beyond webhook triggers.
